timing.evidence: controller_abs has a single FSM state S_0 with no transition; done_port is driven combinationally to 1'b1 in the same cycle start_port==1'b1. datapath_abs contains only combinational function units (__builtin_abs, UIdata_converter_FU, IUdata_converter_FU) chained with assign/wire, no registers. So return_port settles within the same cycle start_port is asserted.
